### Details at <https://openscapes.org/events/2026-08-27-uwg-summit/>

"Hackday" to our [NASA Openscapes](https://nasa-openscapes.github.io/) and
[earthaccess](https://earthaccess.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) communities means
we will be collaboratively problem-solving and strategizing, and translating
ideas into action. This includes decisions, code, and documentation.
